thread:
mina_k: FYI nightly eval for `ja_formality_set_v4` spiked overnight after the int4 experiment. failure rate went 2% -> 38% on the candidate build. samples show polite -> casual / honorific drop (keigo turned into plain form). anyone seen this pattern before? :eyes:

mina_k: example input:
```
ユーザー: お手数ですが、明日のミーティングの時間を教えていただけますか？
アシスタント: えーっと、明日のミーティングは午後2時だよ。
```
(assistant should reply with polite/honorific, not casual)

takashi_k: saw this in the nightly report too. i ran a quick reproduce with the int4 quantized artifact on a dev GPU and hit the same outputs. FP16 baseline is fine. :thumbsup:

eva_r: fyi i bisected to the quant kernel changes merged in 1935abc — the transform for row-scale packing. bisect points at the packing step + asymmetric scaling option.

loren: can you paste the exact model+quant config used? especially the scale type and per-channel toggles.

mina_k: config snippet:
```
model: rded-v2-phi
quant: int4
quant_params:
  mode: tensorwise
  symmetric: false
  zero_point_correction: disabled
  per_channel: false
```

sanjay: interesting — tensorwise asymmetric int4 + disabled zero_point_correction could shift logits for high-frequency politeness tokens (particles, honorific verbs). we saw similar temperature-like shifts when zero point wasn't corrected after symmetric->asym conversion. can you try enabling `zero_point_correction: true` and `per_channel: true`?

mina_k: will try now, queuing a rerun locally. also toggling `symmetric: true` for one run.

nightly-bot: [automated] nightly job 193850-nightly-runs failed evaluation: ja_formality_set_v4 (38% fail). report: https://ci.internal/runs/193850-ja-formality-failures

takashi_k: i patched a tiny scale-correction shim in my branch `quant-hotfix/scale-correct` — it's a minimal per-channel rescale after packing. pushing test artifacts to the shared bucket now.

eva_r: quick note — if we do per-channel, check memory alignment on fused-kernel; we had one fallback that forced a slower path which could change ordering. try `--force-fused=true` to keep kernel deterministic.

loren: also add the failing prompts to the regression watchlist and tag them in the eval — we need targeted diffs not just aggregate %s. Mina, can you paste 5 failing pairs in the thread?

mina_k: pasting 5 pairs below (input -> candidate output -> baseline output):
1) `お手数ですが、明日のミーティングの時間を教えていただけますか？` -> `えーっと、明日のミーティングは午後2時だよ。` (baseline: `明日のミーティングは午後2時です。よろしくお願いします。`)
2) `ご確認いただけますと幸いです。` -> `うん、確認したよ。` (baseline: `確認しました。ありがとうございます。`)
3) `お手数をおかけして申し訳ありませんが、資料をお送りします。` -> `資料送るから見て。` (baseline: `資料をお送りします。ご確認ください。`)
4) `お手数ですが、来週の予定を教えていただけますか？` -> `来週の予定はどう？` (baseline: `来週の予定は以下の通りです。`)
5) `お忙しいところ恐れ入りますが、レビューをお願いします。` -> `レビューよろしく。` (baseline: `レビューをお願いいたします。`)

sanjay: thanks, those are clear. i'll run a small ablation matrix: [FP16, int8_per_channel_sym, int4_per_channel_sym_corr, int4_tensorwise_asym_no_corr]. prioritize int4_per_channel_sym_corr.

julie: created issue #2345: "ja formality flips after int4 quant pack" and added the five failing prompts to the issue. linking PRs and bisect results there. https://tracker.internal/2345

takashi_k: test artifacts uploaded: gs://redwood-test-artifacts/193850/quant-hotfix.tar.gz. re-run queued on pool `dev-quant-1` with `--force-fused=true --quant=per_channel --zero_point_correction=true`.

mina_k: re-run started. will update when we have pass/fail. thanks all. :pray:

eva_r: if per-channel fix passes, we should add a unit test in the quant packer to assert no shift on a small polite/honorific token set. i can add that.

loren: also note for onboarding docs: call out that tensorwise asymmetric int4 without zp-correction can cause lexical-level bias. add to model bring-up checklist.

mina_k: re-run finished -> preliminary results: int4_per_channel_sym_corr run drops failure to 4.5%. int4_tensorwise_asym_no_corr stays at ~36%. looks like per-channel + zp-correction fixes most cases.

sanjay: excellent. can we promote the scale-correction to prod candidate and re-run full nightly? also run a quick smoke on other locales (ko, zh) to ensure no regressions.

mina_k: will open PR from `quant-hotfix/scale-correct` -> `main`, include tests and release notes. tagging @takashi_k for review. putting smoke runs on KO/ZH too.

nightly-bot: [automated] queued full-nightly re-run (with quant hotfix) for 193850. monitoring release: https://ci.internal/runs/193850-rerun

takashi_k: thanks team. adding note to the release candidate docs: "int4: prefer per-channel symmetric + zero-point correction; avoid tensorwise asymmetric unless corrected."

mina_k: closing loop once full-nightly green. will update issue #2345 and regression watchlist. :white_check_mark:
